description: This Java class 'PlaceholderSubstitution' applies placeholder substitution on objects implementing 'WithDittoHeaders' based on their 'DittoHeaders'. It provides static methods to instantiate with default or extended replacement definitions and uses strategies to perform substitutions asynchronously.

classes.name: PlaceholderSubstitution
classes.description: A final class implementing a function that performs placeholder substitution asynchronously on 'WithDittoHeaders' objects, using configurable strategies and algorithms.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new PlaceholderSubstitution instance with default replacement definitions.

methods.name: newExtendedInstance
methods.description: Creates a new PlaceholderSubstitution instance with default replacements extended with additional replacements.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies the placeholder substitution logic asynchronously on the provided 'WithDittoHeaders' object.
